description: Check Kubernetes manifests for privileged containers, root users, host networking, mutable :latest tags and writable root filesystems, and deliver a hardened copy of each document. Before applying manifests, to catch the common pod-security mistakes. Do not choose this when you need admission-control policy evaluation or schema validation. Example requests: Harden this Kubernetes manifest and show me what was unsafe. | Are these deployment manifests running privileged containers? | Give me a hardened version of my k8s YAML.
